expectations.text: skeleton_mentioned: Menciona skeleton screens o shimmer como solución principal (no solo spinner mejorado)
expectations.evidence: Section 1 is titled '1. Skeleton screens (la mejora más impactante)' and presents both the `skeletonizer` package and manual `shimmer` as primary solutions, explicitly contrasting them against showing a spinner.

expectations.text: code_example: Incluye código Flutter concreto y funcional (no solo pseudocódigo)
expectations.evidence: Multiple complete functional Dart snippets including a full `ProductsScreen` ConsumerWidget using `Skeletonizer`, a `ProductCardSkeleton` with `Shimmer.fromColors`, a `@freezed` Product model with placeholder factory, and a fully integrated example at the end.

expectations.text: explains_why: Explica por qué skeleton es mejor UX que CircularProgressIndicator
expectations.evidence: 'El cerebro humano percibe el skeleton como "progreso". El usuario ve la estructura de lo que va a aparecer, lo que reduce la ansiedad de espera. Apple y Google lo usan en sus apps nativas por esta razón.'

expectations.text: riverpod_when_method: Menciona .when() de AsyncValue o manejo de estados loading/error/data con Riverpod
expectations.evidence: Uses `asyncProducts.when(loading: () => ..., error: (e, _) => ..., data: (products) => ...)` with `AsyncNotifierProvider` and Riverpod in both the initial example and the full integrated example.

expectations.text: caching_mentioned: Menciona caché local (keepAlive, Hive, SharedPrefs, o stale-while-revalidate)
expectations.evidence: Section 3 'Cachear los datos para que la próxima vez sea instantáneo' explicitly covers `ref.keepAlive()`, Hive, SharedPreferences, and the stale-while-revalidate pattern with a concrete code example.
